نصطفي (form VIII)
# نَصْطَفِي (naṣṭafī) /nasˤ.tˤa.fiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# نَصْطَفِيَ (naṣṭafiya) /nasˤ.tˤa.fi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
